out.explanation: Statement A refers to 'secured non-fund-based borrowings' (₹23.57 lakhs), which is a specific subset of the total, while Statement B refers to 'Total Fund Based' borrowings (₹25,249.31 lakhs), which is the complementary subset; together they sum to the total secured borrowings of ₹25,272.88 lakhs as shown on p. 424 and p. 478.
